title: AI 要跨越盧比孔河了嗎？自我成長的 AI 離我們多遠 (上集)
notes: Korean topic-aligned paraphrases, not a verbatim transcript. Timings locate the relevant statements rather than exact slide-transition frames. Page 46 named self-training systems are reserved for chapter 10.

topic_alignment.paraphrase: Interprets the second gradient term as increasing the probability of lower-entropy paths; contrasts it with decreasing entropy along a sampled path.

Reports speech-recognition experiments on three corpora; error rates are lower-is-better and adding the extra gradient term helps in the three displayed settings. Explicitly says this experiment is speech recognition, not a large language model experiment.
Recaps allowing AI to define its loss and train itself, but notes humans still choose the model inputs.
Asks whether the model can also find its own inputs, then produce and evaluate outputs and train itself within the loop.
